assertions.description: Closed canonical schema objects do not provide an explicit optional extension map.
assertions.expected: Unknown optional extension fields should be preserved or tolerated through an explicit extension surface.
assertions.observed: The root, metadata, spec, status, protocol, component, checksum, provenance, SBOM, and signature objects are closed with no extensions map; metadata optional extension would be rejected by schema.

assertions.description: Mutable status and queue/controller fields are included in portable distribution identity.
assertions.expected: Distribution identity should bind immutable distribution declaration, not review routing or implementation state.
assertions.observed: Changing only these status fields changed the payload/distribution digest: recommended_next_task, status_status, proposed_capability, implementation_boolean

assertions.description: Semantic component graph validation does not prove content digest, artifact-ref closure, dependency closure, or component_id uniqueness.
assertions.expected: Corrupted component digests, missing artifact refs, unknown dependencies, duplicate component IDs, and cycles should fail closed.
assertions.observed: The following malformed cases validated successfully: corrupt_component_content_digest, missing_artifact_ref, unknown_component_dependency, duplicate_component_id_different_ref, dependency_cycle

assertions.description: Artifact validation does not fully compare committed metadata with actual artifact bytes and type.
assertions.expected: Byte counts, media type, and compression declarations should be validated for included local archive artifacts.
assertions.observed: The following malformed cases validated successfully: wrong_byte_count, wrong_media_type, wrong_compression_format

assertions.description: Release artifact projection touches filesystem paths before semantic path validation.
assertions.expected: Malformed source artifact paths should be rejected before exists/stat/open/hash or traversal.
assertions.observed: Source inspection shows path existence/stat/hash operations occur before any containment or forbidden-member validation in the release artifact projector.

assertions.description: Checksum validation accepts a checksum entry with the correct name but the wrong digest value.
assertions.expected: Checksum validation should verify algorithm, key uniqueness, and value equality with the artifact content digest.
assertions.observed: A probe checksum manifest with the same artifact basename and a wrong digest value validated successfully.

assertions.description: Protocol range validation does not enforce lower bounds, reader/writer fields, or component compatibility constraints.
assertions.expected: Ranges should prove v1 inclusion, min <= max, required reader/writer fields, and coherent component constraints.
assertions.observed: The following malformed compatibility cases validated successfully: lower_bound_above_v1, missing_min, missing_reader_version, missing_writer_version, incompatible_component_constraints

assertions.description: Local-directory distribution inventory silently skips forbidden source-state members.
assertions.expected: A contaminated distribution source should emit explicit contamination/refusal evidence or define a separate filtered-export proof boundary.
assertions.observed: Source inspection shows directory inventory continues past forbidden members rather than recording a refusal.

assertions.description: The committed fixture corpus does not cover required adversarial cases.
assertions.expected: Required direct fixtures should exist for the distribution manifest contract and known risk matrix.
assertions.observed: Missing fixture cases: duplicate-component-id, malformed-digest, wrong-component-digest, wrong-payload-digest, wrong-distribution-digest, missing-artifact-ref, missing-dependency, dependency-cycle, unsupported-source, unknown-optional-feature, unsupported-protocol-range, inverted-protocol-range, forbidden-member, source-contamination, checksum-missing, checksum-wrong-value, checksum-basename-collision, signature-placeholder, false-signature-verification, missing-sbom, unknown-optional-extension-round-trip
